criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 3, 4 and 9 are genuinely drawn. The gooseneck on 1 is relit per segment with a dark left flank, a mid body and a feldspar specular and reads as switched-off metal at 432px. Frame 3's sawn arris has a lit crown with a graded under-shadow over a crystalline field that thins with distance, and it is the one frame a reader would screenshot. Frame 4's socket shows a back wall, a lit bed lip and a shadowed head, so it never reads as a redaction. Frame 9's lit jamb face is a real structural reversal. Against that, FRAME 7 BREAKS THE DECK'S ONE STRUCTURAL LAW ON AN UNDECLARED FRAME: the panel bleeds off the left frame edge so the lit left edge its dossier names as the focal does not exist in the render, there is no specular anywhere on it, and its flat face is unambiguously the frame's brightest AREA at roughly 55 percent of the frame, which its own acceptance line says is false. FRAME 8 CARRIES NO ENGRAVING: no white-line intaglio, no hatch, only two brushed plates, so the stated reason for the technique describes something that did not get drawn. The consequence is the deck's real craft problem, one primitive carrying frames 6, 8 and 9 with 7 as a flat fourth and 2's reserve as a fifth. The declared key at 8 degrees elevation is not what rendered: every cast shadow is a short soft offset consistent with a key well above 45 degrees.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Scored on what is visible on the frames rather than on a source fetch. Every frame carries claim ids in its mono line. Both figures on 8 sit inside the bounded field that names their book. Frame 4 prints no interval numeral, as declared. The build amendments are the right calls: the Capitol gloss struck from 1, 'Nurses picketed' downgraded to c19's own wording, c18 excluded from the deck rather than trusted to a layout. Frame 2 sets the listing string verbatim without the house ordinal while 4 recomposes and takes it, which is the carve-out applied correctly in both directions.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A reader gets the body, the room, the hour, the canceled date, the date the listing carries now and a question to bring on frame 9, which got its own typographic rank. It names no county and the storyboard is honest that it is a placeless story. The stake is diluted in the middle: frames 6 and 8 are three school districts and Dell's quarter, neither of which touches the canceled hearing.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe and frame 5 is a real turn that lands without words, at 91.8 against a deck median of 20.4. Frames 1 to 5 build cleanly. Then 6, 7 and 8 are three unconnected exhibits and the momentum sags exactly where the drawing also thins, and 9 has to restart the deck to land.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: 'Nine in the morning. No hearing.', 'One course. One block never laid.' and 'The room is booked again.' are plain, flat and unmistakably not a press release. Frame 5 splits the source's colon into two sentences rather than setting one, which is the house rule honoured at a cost. Against that, three of nine hooks use the identical two-beat parallel construction, which starts to read as a device rather than a voice.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The stone token at #6B3C39 is off deck 1 and deck 8's #9A3B2A, and the run recorded a measured deck median that sits between priors rather than rounding it toward the plan, which is the honest disposition. Four techniques are genuinely distinct from the fortnight. One familiar move, the full-bleed document frame. The deck's internal repetition of the plate primitive is priced in artwork_craft and not counted twice.

one_sentence_fix: Relight frame 7 so the panel's lit left edge is actually on the frame and the key lands on that edge instead of on its face, because as rendered it is a flat card that breaks the deck's one structural law on an undeclared frame and it is the frame carrying the deck's only human voice.
